press_1_gate.en: Emergency referral call. Press 1 to hear the referral.
press_1_gate.hi: Aapaatkaaleen referral call. Referral sunne ke liye 1 dabaayein.
press_1_gate.kn: Turtu referral kare. Referral kelalu 1 otti.

dtmf_menu.en: Press 1 to Accept, Press 2 to Counter, Press 3 to Decline.
dtmf_menu.hi: Sveekaar karne ke liye 1, Counter ke liye 2, Asveekaar karne ke liye 3 dabaayein.

pin_prompt.en: Please enter your 4-digit PIN followed by hash.
pin_prompt.hi: Kripya apna 4-digit PIN darj karein aur hash dabaayein.
pin_prompt.kn: Dayavittu nimma 4-digit PIN mattu hash otti.
